name: agentodoo
description: See your Odoo tasks and log hours from Claude. Nothing is written to Odoo until you press Confirm.
long_description: AgentOdoo reads your open and unassigned Odoo tasks and projects, and plans new tasks and timesheet lines. Every write is shown as a card with Confirm and Cancel; nothing is written until you confirm. It never edits or deletes anything in Odoo. Works with Odoo 14 and newer.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check server version, login and required fields (read-only).

tools.name: projects
tools.description: Projects where I have open tasks, or search any active project or client (read-only).

tools.name: tasks
tools.description: Open tasks assigned to me or with no assignee (read-only).

tools.name: set_closing_stages
tools.description: Remember which stages mean finished, after you confirm them. Stored on this computer; never writes to Odoo.

tools.name: plan_task
tools.description: Plan one new task assigned to me; shows a card to confirm. Writes nothing by itself.

tools.name: plan_time
tools.description: Plan one timesheet line of mine; shows a card to confirm. Writes nothing by itself.

tools.name: apply_plan
tools.description: Write a saved plan only after the user confirms it.

odoo_url.title: Odoo URL
odoo_url.description: Your Odoo address, starting with https://, for example https://odoo.example.com

database.title: Database
database.description: Odoo database name (ask your admin if unsure)

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create it in Odoo: your avatar → My Profile → Account Security → New API Key. Stored in your system keychain.

max_daily_hours.title: Daily hours limit
max_daily_hours.description: Most hours you can log on one day, across all projects
